prompt: Create a single 1536x1024 landscape school activity HANDLING REFERENCE, full-body camera from south/front of exact outdoor workbench environment ref2. Exact SIX actors from ref1: five pupils Mila mouse, Lulu rabbit, PinPin hedgehog, Tutu squirrel, Bruno badger cub, plus owl teacher; no parents/baby/Elder. Shared scale ref1 authority: tiny Mila about half PinPin height, Bruno just taller than PinPin; owl tallest. Low table must be child waist-height and all paws reach naturally. Fixed broad step at FRONT LEFT lets tiny Mila stand with hindfeet planted and see/reach tabletop, not floating. PinPin stands at FAR CENTER side table looking down, gently holding ONE light flat bark roof slab with his TWO forepaws at its two side edges, lowering it just ABOVE two close wooden block supports. Lulu at LEFT table end holds left support with two rabbit forepaws, hindfeet on ground. Tutu at RIGHT end holds right support with two squirrel forepaws, hindfeet grounded, ONE red tail. Model prop appearance from ref3: exactly TWO smooth rectangular pale blocks and ONE bark slab, no house walls/gables. Slab spans both close supports, toy total width around PinPin full body height, blockheight one-quarter PinPin height. There is only one slab, hovering a tiny gap above supports because PinPin paws visibly support it. Mila stands on fixed step FRONT LEFT, waits holding a green leaf carrying ONE small pinecone in her two paws, clear of roof operation. Bruno stands FRONT RIGHT holds ONE small wooden cup in two forepaws, waits without pouring. Owl stands on ground BEHIND RIGHT observing, two wings folded naturally. Everyone gaze target active toy, not camera. Snack tray with five cups and bowl removed offscreen for activity, under-table tray remains. Tabletop mostly empty except model and cup/cone with holders; leave gap between bodies, enough negative space to count all five pupils. Camera high enough to see tabletop but low enough to see full feet and fixedstep. Preserve pavilion left, snag rear, oak right, clear morning/daylight. Beautiful warm dimensional storybook fur/quills/bark, no clothes, text, extra limbs or duplicated pupils.
review: Rejected for anatomy: PinPin has correct two forepaws on roof and two grounded hindfeet, but also a duplicated pair of small paws at the tabletop below his belly. Other five actors, fixed mouse step reach, props and spatial arrangement useful. Targeted removal of duplicate tabletop paws required before selection.
